palette.name: Cloud Gray
palette.role: Page canvas, card borders, hairline dividers, image frames — the dominant neutral that defines the surface field

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary text, filled action buttons, hero overlays, footer — the anchor that gives the minimal palette its weight

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces, content backgrounds, button text on dark fills

palette.name: Sand Beige
palette.role: Soft section background, alternate surface, and quiet card fill.

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Muted body text, secondary links, helper text — recedes so Obsidian can lead
